info.name: Get resources that are related to a resource identified by IRI

params.name: owner
params.description:
User name and unique identifier of the user or organization a resource belongs to.
For example, in the URL: https://acme.data.world/jonloyens/an-intro-to-dataworld-dataset, jonloyens is the unique identifier of the owner.

params.name: iri
params.description: Internationalized Resource Identifier (IRI) of the resource. You can find the IRI in the Technical Reference section under the Settings tab on the resource’s catalog page.

params.name: hydrations
params.description: Return additional information about the resource. For example, if the resource is in a collection, the collection IRI will be returned by default. If hydration is enabled, the collection's title and description will also be returned.

params.name: next
params.description: A token supplied by the previous response to retrieve the next page of results

items.docs: If a resource A is related to resource B and C, this endpoint will return B and C. See request body for further filtering options.

info.name: Creates a relationship between two catalog resources identified by IRI

params.name: owner
params.description:
User name and unique identifier of the user or organization a resource belongs to.
For example, in the URL: https://acme.data.world/jonloyens/an-intro-to-dataworld-dataset, jonloyens is the unique identifier of the owner.

items.docs: Creates a directed relationship between two catalog resources with one being the source and the other being the target.
